basics.name: Mireia Bru
basics.label: Product Owner & Architect – AI/ML
basics.summary: 7+ years shipping software, managing teams, and owning product in automotive and tech. Currently building production AI/ML products at Scania (TRATON R&D); previously led two teams at Volvo Cars delivering a global e-commerce platform from zero. I love hard problems, new tech, and the outdoors. Happiest when the pace is fast and the challenge is complex.

work.name: Scania
highlights: Own the product roadmap for generative AI tools supporting R&D across TRATON's brands, balancing stakeholder needs with technical feasibility.
Lead development of production-ready AI products built on RAG architectures, LLMs, and internal data platforms, from early-stage prototypes to deployed solutions.
Hands-on across the stack: build and iterate on features while coordinating with ML engineers, data engineers, and domain experts.

work.name: Volvo Cars
highlights: Led two cross-functional teams (8–12 engineers) within Commercial Digital, delivering the Online Sales accessories platform, a new global revenue stream for Volvo Cars.
Owned delivery end-to-end: sprint planning, hiring, 1:1s, performance reviews, architectural decisions, and stakeholder alignment.
Stayed hands-on technically: contributed to frontend architecture decisions, code reviews, and critical path features in React/TypeScript.

work.name: Volvo Cars
highlights: Built the next-generation car configuration experience, redefining how users explore and personalize vehicles on volvo.com.

work.name: Mentimeter
highlights: Built interactive features and premium capabilities for the core presentation editor at a high-growth SaaS startup (10M+ users).

work.name: Zooplus
highlights: Founding team member for an internal promotions management SPA built with Vue.js and TypeScript, enabling campaign management across 90+ European markets.
